entities.summary: Arthur Cazaux is a French professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 58, achieved on 13 October 2025 and a doubles ranking of No. 430, achieved on 1 November 2021. Cazaux has won four Challenger singles titles.
